title: Share KDE laptop's WiFi to Android smartphone over Bluetooth
line: Bluetooth settings now have a "Share Internet connection" switch that lets paired phones get online through the computer.
explanation: Plasma's Bluetooth settings could only join a phone's Bluetooth network (NAP); there was no way to host one, so users needed blueman-services to share their laptop's connection with a phone. NetworkManager can host one with a bridge connection that carries a Bluetooth setting of type "nap", but NetworkManagerQt had no Nap profile type and dropped the bluetooth setting from bridge connections. NetworkManagerQt now has the Nap type and keeps the bluetooth setting on bridges (it is only sent when initialized, so other bridges are unchanged). The Bluetooth KCM's Settings page gets a "Share Internet connection" switch that builds that bridge (pan0, bluetooth NAP, IPv4 shared) with the typed NetworkManagerQt API and adds and activates it in one call; NetworkManager then registers the network server with BlueZ and gives connected devices DHCP and NAT. Turning the switch off deletes the connection.

commits.message:
settings: support Bluetooth NAP settings on bridge connections

NetworkManager serves a Bluetooth network through a bridge connection with
a bluetooth setting of type "nap", but bridges dropped that setting and the
profile type had no value for it. Add the Nap type and keep the setting.

BUG: 523139

kcm: add a switch to share the Internet connection over Bluetooth

Plasma could connect to a phone's Bluetooth network, but couldn't offer
its own connection to paired devices. The settings page now has a switch
that adds a NetworkManager bridge acting as a Bluetooth network server.

BUG: 523139

media.caption: Bluetooth settings on master: no way to share the computer's connection
Switch turned on with the real NetworkManager and BlueZ: a second Bluetooth controller acting as the phone pairs, connects, gets an address from the computer and loads kde.org through it
If NetworkManager refuses, the error is shown and the switch goes back off
